<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex036012026-04-1301-16-04" status="reviewed">sgyur lugs ni 
            <note type="gloss">rgya</note> a rgya zhes pa na 'phags pa'o || mu la na gzhi' 'o ||
            sa r+ba na thaMd do || 
            <lb edRef="inst:7313" n="5a6"/> a ti<note type="gloss">For the Sanskrit asti</note> na yod par ro || 
            bad<note type="gloss">For the Sanskrit vāda (in the title: vādi)</note> na smra ba'o || 
            <note type="gloss">rgya</note> sh+ra ma ne ra na dge' tshul lo || 
            ka ri ka na tshig le 'ur byas pa'o || 
            'bri ti na 'grel pa'o || 
            pra ba ba ti na 'od ldan no ||</seg></TEI>
source: 2_036_01 sBal ti jo sras_grel pa od ldan gyi tshig don gsal byed.xml
